notes.title: Rogue Knight 1.1.0 new upgrade shop
notes.content:
New content: Cultist

Cultist will provide repeating upgrades. As you raise your Damnation level you will get much more materials, Cultist will be there to help you spend them. Surely they will not go to any nefarious purposes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762072/600162b5d2af1755c42f906905b0cb1d5eb98760.png

Cultist is available in town after reaching stage 5 (Palace). For existing stages he will already be there if you killed Cursed King on that save. His upgrades are not required for Perfectionist achievment.

New content:

 3 new epic spells
 3 new legendary spell
 2 new legendary items


Balance:

 Wind charges now regenerate much faster out of combat
 Sentinel (stage 4 boss) nerfed
 Stages 2 and 3 are slightly easier
 Legendary items that gave 100% resistance now give 80%
 True Sword Essence 10 -> 12 base damage

notes.title: Rogue Knight 1.0.5
notes.content:
New leatherworker upgrade: Spacious Compartments doubles stack size of materials (from 12 to 24)
On Damnations levels 1 and higher dark crystals (highest tier upgrade material) starts dropping from stage 3 (normally stage 4)
